markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (>99%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds only Invasive, and the second model and all 5 similar cases agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive >99%; InSitu <1% | One-sided |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 86th percentile | Reliable; mildly atypical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Neighbors agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 9) · ↑ invasive · Stromal infiltration scored above typical [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 2, 9) · ↑ invasive · Pleomorphism scored above typical · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 4, 8) · ↑ invasive · Necrosis scored above typical; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Normal lobules** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scored below typical; spot check 0/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) distorts scores; reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Region 11 holds benign or in situ tissue; its normal-lobule score is Unreliable.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 7, 3** — highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive tumor.
2. **Region 11** — only region with benign-leaning scores; its lateral margin segment scored 1%.
3. **Region 10** — inferior margin segment scored 17%, against the "tumor at all margins" call.
